title: When the Spire Breaks Revisited
author: Marguerite Amberdale
blurb: Cyrus Nakamura, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
